arcs.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
arcs.summary: Day 1: The Jeep departed at six forty-one. The waymarker at the gorge mouth logged their passage at seven fifty-three. The creek crossing was expected between nine and half past. No dispatches have been received from the hollow itself — none were expected. The table is empty. The house is in Lucy's capable and unaccountable hands. Day 2 should be the return: the Jeep comes home with mud, something new marked on the chart, and the one thing from the hollow that nobody expected — the creek crossing result, whatever the ridge gave them, and what the duck looked like when they arrived at the second circle.
